title: Energy and Transport Corridors
grammar: Stating a Condition: azzal a megkötéssel, hogy
goal: I can describe the north-south energy and transport links of Central Europe.
I can state a condition or a reservation with *azzal a megkötéssel, hogy* and *azzal a fenntartással, hogy*.
I can explain why the region wanted more than one source of energy.
